Author: Ehno
Name: XIV Venue Manager Sync
Punchline: In-game companion for xivvenuemanager.com — log patron visits, sales, and services without leaving FFXIV.
Description: In-game companion for XIV Venue Manager, a venue-management platform for FFXIV player-run venues (xivvenuemanager.com). Tracks patron entry and exit at your venue, logs sales and services to your web dashboard in real time, and keeps guest lists in sync with the staff, roles, and services you configure on the website. Set up an account at xivvenuemanager.com, generate an API key from the dashboard, and paste it into this plugin's Settings tab to start syncing.
Changelog:
v3.10.7: Internal refactor — deduped repeated HTTP request/error-handling code across the venue, shift, and patron API classes into 2 shared helpers. No user-visible feature changes; a few inconsistent debug-log messages were tightened to match their siblings. Testing channel, not yet verified against a live game client.
v3.10.6: Fixed exterior header staying on "(no venue)" for a venue saved before exterior tracking shipped when approached from outside before ever going in (now heals by matching physical location, not just the old interior-only id). Fixed chat sync messages firing in every house you walk into instead of just registered venues. VIP and ban badges now refresh automatically every 30s instead of requiring a manual Fetch Venues. Sales dropdown and Inventory tab stock count now update immediately after a sale instead of waiting for the next resync.
v3.10.5: Fixed header/venue name not updating on re-entry to a venue already visited this session (leave then come back) - a duplicate-key crash was silently cutting off the name update, likely pre-existing but far easier to hit now that leaving and re-entering via the exterior is trivial.
v3.10.4: Fixed exterior-plot tracking never starting when the plot exterior is entered directly (without going inside first) - entry now polled, not just event-driven, since walking onto a plot from within an already-loaded ward has no zone-change event to hook.
v3.10.3: Fixed exterior-plot tracking breaking entirely when entering the plot exterior directly, without going inside first - a single transient misread on the first tick could kill tracking with no way to recover it. Now debounced.
v3.10.2: Fixed exterior-plot tracking not clearing when you walk off the plot without a full zone change (header/guest list stayed stuck on the last venue).
v3.10.1: Fixed exterior-plot tracking not recognizing an already-saved venue when approached from outside before going in.
v3.10.0: VIP and ban badges in the live guest list. New Rooms tab for room status. New Inventory tab: link drinks to real FFXIV items, track stock, block sales at zero. Patron tracking now works from the plot exterior, not just the house interior.
v3.8.8: Staff can now claim open shifts directly from the Shifts tab.
v3.8.7: Fixed World and Data Center showing as Dev/Unknown in the Venues tab.
v3.8.6: Improved API request compatibility with CDN layers.
